description: Erection of a part two, part single storey side extension, single storey rear infill extension, part first floor rear extension, rear roof dormer extension with two front roof lights, relocation of main entrance door from the side to front elevations, replacement of first floor rear window and associated internal alterations to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (21025-2002 (Rev 07)  Received:  16 December 2021;  21025-2002 (Rev 06)  Received:  19 November 2021;  21025-1000 (Rev 01); 21025-1001 (Rev 01); 21025-2001 (Rev 01); 21025-2002 (Rev 01)  Received:  15 November 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be inserted in the part two, part single storey side extension, single storey rear infill extension, first floor rear extension and rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
